The schedule is Dev, Cara, Hana, Ann, Ben, Ivo, Finn, Gus, Elif in slots 1 to 9. I rechecked it against all 17 constraints and every one holds.

The team note (Ann in slot 6, Cara in slot 4) can't be right. Exactly one person must sit between Ann and Cara, which forces Hana into slot 5, right after Cara. Ivo, Finn and Gus need three consecutive slots after Cara, and only slots 7 to 9 are free. But Elif and Ben must both come after Ann, so they also need slots 7 to 9. That is a conflict.

I did not check every other possible position for Cara, so I haven't shown this is the only valid schedule.
